subject: Next steps: trial success KPIs, ownership, and timelines
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha King <samantha.king@finserve.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@finserve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff call - proposed KPIs and owner map

Thanks again for a productive kickoff today. Quick recap from our side with proposed success KPIs, ownership, and immediate next steps so we can lock the trial scope. Please review and confirm or flag changes by end of day tomorrow.

TL;DR proposed success KPIs
- Latency: median 95th percentile token latency under 220ms for 1k concurrent sessions
- Cost: average per-response token cost under 0.9x baseline target used in your evaluation sheet
- Quality: 8/10 accuracy on the 50-case prompt set you shared; no regressions compared to baseline prompts
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during business hours (PST) for the trial window

Proposed owner map (RACI-lite)
- Infra / provisioning: Redwood dedicated infra owner - Ben Carter (redwood) - R
- App integration / feature hooks: FinServe dev lead - Tom Li - A/R
- Security review / questionnaire: FinServe security - Samantha King - A; Redwood security contact - Laura Bennett - C/R for evidence
- Procurement / contracts: FinServe procurement - Samantha and legal, Redwood sales ops - Karthik Iyer - C/R

Deliverables we are attaching: trial_timeline_v2.xlsx, FinServe_MOU_v1.pdf. I also attached a short MOU with proposed 6-week evaluation window and acceptance gates linked to the KPIs above.

Immediate next steps
1) Customer to confirm owners for app and internal security contact (Samantha/Tom) and confirm any additional KPIs by 10/21 EOD.
2) Redwood to share completed security questionnaire and contact info for our security lead (we will share Laura's contact).
3) Schedule a 90-minute technical workshop next week to validate integration points and KV/cache strategies. Propose 10/22 11am PT or 10/23 9am PT.

Attachments: trial_timeline_v2.xlsx (stub), FinServe_MOU_v1.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Marcus

Subject: Re: Trial kickoff call - proposed KPIs and owner map

Appreciate the clear recap Marcus. This matches our notes for the most part. A few quick items from FinServe:

1) Security contact: I will be the owner for our side for the questionnaire and evidence collection. Please send the questionnaire and a point of contact for any technical security discussions.
2) KPIs: we are fine with latency and availability targets. For quality, can we add a secondary KPI for hallucination rate below 3% on the 50-case set? We will run our automated evals and share results weekly.
3) Timeline: 6-week window is fine, but procurement needs an estimated SOW and stub contract to start internal review. Can Redwood provide an editable MOU and an expected statement of work line items by tomorrow?

We can confirm owners for app integration after a short internal sync; tentatively Tom will be primary and I will be the approver on security and procurement.

Proposed workshop: 10/22 11am PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Samantha King

- Redwood security technical evidence: Laura Bennett - C/R

Agreed KPIs (final)
- Latency: median 95th percentile token latency under 220ms for 1k concurrent sessions
- Cost: average per-response token cost under 0.9x baseline
- Quality: 8/10 accuracy on the 50-case prompt set AND hallucination rate below 3%
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during business hours (PST) for the trial window
